reason: Under the transfer/leakage lens the judge cannot certify what it is built to certify. (1) Same embryo: dorado IS the 44b6 recording, and Stage 1 boxes are late frames (t>=300) of that same embryo. The failures we need to explain are about embryo shift: probe 29 ef_a3 lab +0.0162 gave a 0.947 tie; probe 30 ef_a0 +0.0095 gave -0.001; probe 21 relink-off +0.0053 gave -0.002. Private is ~71% other embryos. At best the judge models 'unseen cells or images in a seen embryo', so any network-trusting gain it passes still carries the embryo-shift discount. For network-free items (float coords, geometric fork rules), the existing real-GT lab (129k evaluable edges, both embryos) is already close to unbiased and beats a pseudo-GT. The judge adds decision value in neither case. (2) The seen-arm calibration is nearly tautological. CONTEXT 23 Sep 23:30 says 654/777 GT nodes of a 44b6 clip coincide exactly with Ultrack points, so host GT is proofread Ultrack. The seen arm is further filtered to Ultrack pieces that agree with GT on >=80% of frames, so it matches real GT by construction, and its label noise is much lower than the unseen arm's. That arm carries raw, unproofread Ultrack: ~16% of annotated-lineage nodes needed correction, and link errors run ~1%/frame. Those errors sit where configs differ: dense, fast and hard spots, the same regions relink/ILP overrides touch. The validity check therefore says nothing about unseen-arm noise. (3) The pass criterion is not diagnostic. Criterion B reads unseen-arm ef_a3 <= +0.004 and ef_a0 <= +0.003 as 'optimism is label memorisation, judge valid'. But the three LB known answers are all ~0 +-0.002-0.003 (LB noise). Two artefacts of this design push deltas toward 0: pseudo-GT noise correlated with the configs, and dropping hard edges (only pieces >=20 frames, cut at divisions and at steps >6 um, which removes the regions where the edge filter and relink act). A judge that just compresses every delta passes the calibration, and it would then also veto real sub-resolution gains. No case with a clear positive LB answer and a network-trusting mechanism is in the calibration set. The zone +0.004 < ef_a3 < +0.010 has no rule at all. (4) Residual label leakage in Stage 0. 'Unseen' is <7 um from no GT node. The edge network's candidate context reaches 10-14 um (relaxed relink 10 um, OUTPUT_EDGE_MAX_UM 14), so many 'unseen' cells were training negatives or context tokens. The detector was trained on those exact images. Stage 0 is out-of-label only, not out-of-sample. (5) The queue shrank. The stitch bundle closed with the edge filter (CONTEXT 16:55). Float coords get a direct LB probe on 25 Sep. Fork-midpoint is a division item the edge-only pseudo-GT cannot judge. The coordhead multiplier share depends on N_pred/N_est, not on GT, so no GT source answers it. That leaves frozen ILP-first (+0.0013, network-trusting, i.e. the class the judge certifies worst) and overlap consensus. Resolution with 11 leak groups is ~+-0.001, the same size as those effects. Stage 1 costs 40 GB of streaming, 1.5-3 h of download and ~1 day of glue for 24 correlated boxes from one late slab window. It cannot be ready before 26-27 Sep, leaving 2 days of probes. Net: decision value ~0 public and at most +0.001 private, bought with a large share of the scarce Claude and user budget.
fix_if_any: Keep only a cheap, falsifiable Stage 0 and drop Stage 1. (a) Add a sharp NEGATIVE control: relink-off (lab +0.0053, LB -0.002) must come out <= 0 on the unseen arm, and ef_a0 must be <= +0.001. (b) Add a POSITIVE control: if probe 31 (coordhead) scores >= 0.951, the unseen arm must show coordhead >= +0.003. If it compresses coordhead as well, the judge is a shrinker; kill it. (c) Build the seen arm with the SAME Ultrack-only rules as the unseen arm: select pieces by proximity to a GT node at their first frame only, follow the raw Ultrack track, and apply no GT-agreement filter. Score those pieces against both real GT and their raw Ultrack version, which measures judge noise on matched cells directly. (d) Raise the 'unseen' exclusion to >= 15 um from any GT node within +-2 frames, i.e. beyond the candidate/relink halo. (e) Keep hard edges: cut only at Ultrack divisions, not at steps >6 um, and report separately the edges inside the configs' change sets. (f) Fill the decision gap: unseen ef_a3 above +0.004 means kill, not Stage 1. (g) Use the judge only as a VETO for topology items. Never use a judge pass to justify shipping a network-trusting change without an LB probe, and treat its verdicts as embryo-shift-blind for private. If (a)-(b) cannot both be met by 25 Sep evening, drop the line and spend the budget on LB probes of network-free items.
realistic_public_gain: ~0 on public (it ships nothing, and remaining items get direct probes anyway). At most +0.000..+0.001 expected on private, from vetoing one in-sample artefact (e.g. frozen ILP-first) in the finals bundle, and only if the negative and positive controls both pass. Stage 1 (same embryo, late frames, 40 GB stream) adds nothing for private transfer.
